texte: But I think there needs to be a federal floor.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: And I believe that the Democrats in the Senate are going to introduce legislation to do just that in the week.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: So I agree with you.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: Well, it certainly be among my first initiatives.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: I can't—sitting here today—predict what will be happening.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: I know that happened to President Obama when he was elected and found out that we were falling into an economic abyss.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: And I think he deserves a lot of credit for restabilizing our situation and getting us back on the economic upswing.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: So but among the priorities that I would be advocating for—in the beginning would be Comprehensive Immigration Reform.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: And one of the reasons for that, in addition to everything we've discussed is as secretary of state, I saw what happens to countries that established a second-class status for people.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: They do not feel that they belong, or they have any allegiance to the country in which they live and work because they're never fully accepted.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: That is a recipe for divisiveness and even for disintegration.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: And there fore, my view strongly is that we are a nation of immigrants.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: We have assimilated tens and tens of millions of people over the course of our history.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: We have 11 million, 12 million people right now who are undocumented.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: The vast majority of whom have proven that they want to be a citizen of this country and we should put them on that path.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: And those who say, \Yes, we can do reform, but not a path to citizenship,\" would be fundamentally undermining what has made America unique—the way we have assimilated people, the way people who come here feel so loyal, the contributions they make.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: So this is not just in my view the right thing to do for America.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: If you compare us to other countries that did not take that step, you can see what it's done to them.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: And I don't want to go there.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: So I very firmly support a path to citizenship in the context of Comprehensive Immigration Reform.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: I bet he'd say the same thing about you.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: But, you know, Juan, you make a good point.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: It's not only about the minimum wage and decent working conditions for people like you and your dad.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: Often times when I have conversations with people who are fearful about immigration reform, their fears are rooted in the feeling that they're losing jobs that are going to people who are undocumented.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: And part of that fear has a reality to it is because if people pay you $6 hour, because you're undocumented.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: Why would they pay somebody who already is a citizen what the minimum wage should be?

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: So my argument is the quicker we can legalize the people who are here, the better the job market will be for everybody because you will not have a group of people who are taken advantage of and you will not have others who feel as though—and to some extent it's true—are losing jobs because this group that is being taken advantage of is paid so much less and treated so much worse.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: So my argument to people who worry about Comprehensive Immigration Reform and the effect on their jobs, it's just the opposite.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: The sooner we can get to legalization, the better the job market will be for everybody.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: Then, employers will not be able to violate the laws—the Wage and Hour Laws for example, because they're not dealing with a workforce that is scared to say anything, or even scared to look at the boss when he shows up on the work site.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: So this is about everybody, not just about you and your dad.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: Well, look I think that that's a big part of what we have to do to make sure that out economy is competitive and also to make sure that every young person has a chance to continue their education whether it's a community college or college or a job training kind of program that will give them a good start.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: And you make a really strong point because it's so expensive to continue your education that too many kids are feeling—and their parents are feeling it's just beyond their reach.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: So that's why I support President Obama's proposal for free community college which at least get you started and I'd like to look to see how we get the debt under control and give people a chance to, you know, not be burdened by debt which makes it really hard for them to start a business or to continue their education.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: So this is going to be a big part of, you know, my education policy as I go forward in the campaign because you're 100 percent right.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: Too many young people today feel like, you know, it's just out of their reach or they graduate with some much debt they feel like they are paralyzed.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: They don't know what to do.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: They can't buy a house, they can't get married, they can't start a business because the have so much in student debt.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: And, you know, then, in Iowa and in New Hampshire, you know, the average student in Iowa graduates with about $30,000 worth of debt, and then, the average student in New Hampshire, about $32,000 worth of debt.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: They're at the higher end.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: Nevada is still at the lower end of debt.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: But, you know, you also have a lot of people who don't have that much in assets and income.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: So it's all, you know, relative to what they can afford.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: So we have to do more on that.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: And I want to put in a big plug before we give you the last word about Rancho because I learned today that this school uses Title I funds to pay for the A.P.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: This is, you know, this sounds a little archane but I want to emphasize how important this is because when you look at high school education, making it possible for more students to have access to advanced placement courses really ups the level of education.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: It gives kids a leg up if they go on to college because they may have some credit before they ever get there.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: But too many kids in the past and still across our country don't take the test because—I don't know what it does today—$80?

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: That's a lot of money if, you know, you're making minimum wage or less.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: So I want to—I really want to—I don't—I hope that the Rancho administrators are still here because—good.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: The principal is still here.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: I want to give them a big shout out for using Title I funding to make sure every kid who wants to take an A.P.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: course gets to and gets to take the exam.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: So I'm sure, you're going to do some of that next year.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: You have them tomorrow?

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: So you're taking three A.P.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: Well, I think it's very shortsighted of us not to legalize students who graduate from college and can use their skills to make a good life for themselves but also to give back.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: We have thousands and thousands of foreign students come to our country every year.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: And they get a great education in our colleges and universities.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: And then, a lot of them stay.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: Well, I want you to be a doctor if that's what you want to be.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: I mean you've come up to our system, you've worked hard, and then you've done exceptionally well.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: So I think this is the particular fix in addition to the other fixes we've been talking about.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: You know, I read an article recently about a group of young, undocumented men who were really interested in technology and they entered a contest against kids from the best schools and companies and they won.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: And so, you have four kids who beat the best of the best.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: And they couldn't do anything because they were undocumented.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: And I am sitting there thinking, \"What is wrong with this picture?\" We are in a global competition and I intend for us to win it.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: And I'm about to let anybody who can make a contribution to our economy and our society get thrown away.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: So from my perspective we need to fix that, we need to remove the fear, and we need to make sure that we give every child a chance to do the best that he or she can.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: And if that means going to Yale and becoming a doctor I want that to happen.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: So, as you can tell, I could be here all day because, you know, six exceptional young people, we have some proud parents and grandparents and teachers here.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: But let me and where I started thanking Rancho for having me here, thanking each of you for being willing and brave enough to sit here and talk about your own lives.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: I want to reiterate my strong support for the president's executive actions because he had to act in the face of inaction that was not on the merits but politically motivated for partisan reasons which I think is not the way we should be solving our problems in our country, in our Congress or anywhere else.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: And I'm so pleased that the congresswoman is here because I know she's a champion for a lot of the issues that we are talking about today.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: And I want to get back to good old-fashioned problem-solving.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: And this is one of the problems we have to solve together.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: So I pledge to you I will do everything I possibly can to make this an issue in the campaign but more importantly, when I'm president, to put it on the top of my priority list.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: So if you'll stay here, we're going to do a picture.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: And maybe we could get the Rancho—the principal and others to come up and join us, you know.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: Let's get the administrators who invited us all here to come and stand.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: If you'll just stand with us we will get a picture with everybody.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: Congresswoman, why don't you join us?

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: Write me a memo about what I need to do differently.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: Yes, you want to come around?

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: And Juan, you're going to give me that.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: Yes, look at Barb and then we'll look at all the very proud parents with their cameras.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: So we'll look over here.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: OK, got some cameras over here.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: It's like when you're on the red carpet and they yell at you.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: You want to come around?

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: OK. Good to meet you, Chris.

titre: Remarks at a Roundtable with Young Nevada Residents in Las Vegas, Nevada
texte: I'm so happy I could.

texte: Is your name Barbara ?

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: I am thrilled to be here with all of you.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And Sarah, that was excellent.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: I thank you so much.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And I hope you'll get to know Sarah and spend time with her and help her as she works so hard between now and February 1st.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And Dean and Gary, thank you for welcoming us to your beautiful home; what a delight it is to be here with you.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: Somebody asked me the other day, well, you know, you're going to these events, where you're taking time to actually talk and listen to people, is that really what you're going to do?

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And I said, well, yes, it is because not only do I learn a lot but I also feel like it's the best way to make those connections that will not only give me a firm foundation in the caucus here in Iowa or in a primary in New Hampshire—because it really is about people-to-people connections if we're really talking about what we want to do—but it will also give me the kind of information I need to be an even better president.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And I just had another example about that.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: You may know that Gary's a radiologist and right before we came in, we were talking about his work.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: He's an expert in breast cancer.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And I asked him about the mammography recommendations that's at least the women in the room I'm sure have seen over the last several years.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And he was giving me some really important insight into the commission that made those recommendations and his expert opinion about them.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And I'm so grateful to you for that because it's the kind of discussion that you can't have unless you have an opportunity to actually talk and listen with people.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: I want to thank all of you for coming.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: I am delighted to have this chance to talk with you.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: I think what we're going to do is I'll say a few words about the campaign and what I want to achieve.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And then we'll have a chance to talk individually and I'll be able to hear from each and every one of you.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: I have been incredibly impressed over the last several years at how hard the American people have worked to pull ourselves out of the Great Recession.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: People have made a lot of sacrifice.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: People have lost jobs.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: They lost the chance to finish or go on with their education.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And they did everything that they could think of to do to get back on their feet.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And I'm so relieved that, as I travel around the country and talk with people, there is a sense that we are on our feet.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: We're not running yet but we are on our feet.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And we can see the changes that are happening in people's lives and put them in a context as to where we go from here now as a country.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: I'm very grateful to President Obama for the hard decisions he made when he inherited the mess that he inherited when he became president in 2009.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And I know that he and I and everyone who was in his administration realizes that, unless the American family and the American worker is strong, everything we want to see happen for our country is going to be much more difficult.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And so I come to this campaign committed to being a champion for Americans and American families.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: That's what my work has been throughout my entire adult life, starting with my first job out of law school when I went to work for the Children's Defense Fund, all the way through to the work that I did as secretary of state promoting women's rights, promoting the rights of people who would otherwise be marginalized or left on the sidelines.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And I know that, although we have to—it's still hard to imagine exactly how we're going to get to the point where people are not just getting by but getting ahead again and staying ahead because, look, the deck is still stacked in favor of those at the top.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And so we have to be especially focused on how we're going to bring about the changes that will ignite opportunity for everybody willing to work hard for it again.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: So when I look at where we are as a nation and where we need to be, I see four big challenges that we have to take on together.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And there are going to be fights, because they're—if they were easy, they would already be done.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: So I will posit that right now.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: Number one, we have to build the economy of tomorrow, not yesterday.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: It needs to be innovative.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: It needs to be sustainable.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: It needs to be producing good jobs with rising wages.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: We need to get back into the habit of actually rewarding workers with increases in their paychecks for the increases in productivity and profitability that they have helped to bring about.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: You know, Warren Buffett has said it, but so have a lot of other people.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: There's something wrong when the average American CEO makes 300 times more than the typical American worker or when hedge fund managers themselves make more and pay less in taxes than nurses and truck drivers.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: In fact, I heard a statistic the other day that really made a big impact on me, that the top 25 hedge fund managers together made more money than all the kindergarten teachers in America.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And when you think about value, what it is that's going to get us moving again, I think kindergarten teachers are really important.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And so——and we've got to make a claim on becoming the 21st century clean energy superpower.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: Iowa has really helped us.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: The RFS, the renewable fuel standard and a lot of the investments that have made here, has been one of the reasons why we have made some real progress but not near enough.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And other countries are going to seize that title unless we do what we have to.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: It's also imperative that we give people the tools through education and job training and skills not just in rhetoric but in reality so that they can make the most out of their own lives.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And for me that starts at the very beginning.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: I have been a child advocate and a child development proponent for my entire adult life because it's what I really care about, what I believe in.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And I think we have to start before kindergarten.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: We have to have universal pre-K but we also have to do more to reach out to families so they know the tools they should use to be their children's first teachers.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: Now we've got this new granddaughter who is unbelievable.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And we were with her this weekend.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: You know, we go and just stare at her.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: I mean, that's what—it's really—it's wonderful and silly at the same time.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: But we also read to her.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: Here she is, 7.5 months old, we're reading and reading and reading.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And I imagine among her first words were—will be, you know, \Enough with the reading,\" because between her mom and her dad and Bill and I, we're constantly doing that.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: But we're doing it not only because we love to do it and we love to see her begin to reach her hands out and grab onto the books, we're doing it because we know that it aids her brain development.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: That has been one of the great discoveries with brain research in the last couple of decades.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: We increasingly can see what happens when you are literally feeding the brain as well as the body of these infants and then the babies and the toddlers.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: That will help them be better prepared when they actually end up in kindergarten and it will begin to close the achievement gap because, you know, we're going to do everything we can for our granddaughter.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: Charlotte will get every opportunity we can possibly imagine.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: But what kind of country will she grow up in?

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And what kind of world will she enter?

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And what will happen to all of the other infants, babies, toddlers and children in our country today?

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: So we have to look at education from the very beginning.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: Then we have to make sure that we are doing all we can to empower our teachers, to make sure that they have the support of parents so that they can do the job they have been trained to do to help prepare our kids.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And then we've got to make sure that college is affordable.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And that cannot happen at the rate we're going unless we change the way we fund college education for young people who wish to have that experience.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: Many of us in this room, I bet, as I did, borrowed money to go to college.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: But then we were able to pay it back because it wasn't such an overwhelming burden as it has become now.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: The average student in Iowa graduates with $30,000 in debt and that then makes it very difficult for them to start a business or buy a new home or even get married, as one young man told me not so long ago.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: So we have to deal with the indebtedness to try to move toward making college as debt-free as possible.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: I'm 100 percent behind President Obama's proposal for free community college.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: We've got to try to get that through.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And then we've got to try to do everything we can to make college available and affordable to all of our young people.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: You know, when you think about our economy today, it is absolutely linked to education.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: It is also linked to strong families and strong communities.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa
texte: And that's our second challenge, because a lot of families and communities have been under tremendous strain.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Event in Mason City, Iowa

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois
texte: I want to say just a few words about what's happening with our economy and more broadly about America's families.

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois
texte: Now I happen to think that kindergarten teachers and child care providers and child development specialists are really important because they are the people that are helping to get our kids off to a good start working with families.

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois
texte: And I'm running for President because I think everyday Americans need a champion, a champion that gets up every single day and goes to work and goes to bat and does everything I can to help families just get by which is what you were talking about.

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois
texte: Now, when we think about strong families being the backbone of our country, we have to recognize that our economy is different and our families are different.

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois
texte: I was born in Chicago and the families of today are not exactly the same as the family I was born into.

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois
texte: You know I can remember very well when I was a young lawyer before I had my daughter in my law firm where I worked in Arkansas, around 3 o'clock I'd see all the women who worked there sort of whispering into their phones and I didn't know why, but it was just like clockwork, well they were trying to make sure their kids got home safely because their kids were walking home or getting off the bus and going home waiting for mom to get home.

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois
texte: Making it so much more difficult.

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois
texte: America cannot turn its back on our children and our working parents.

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois
texte: Family values are economic values.

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois
texte: I'm going to be putting forth plans to fix this.

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois
texte: Because it's now time for us to face reality.

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois
texte: So we've got to have better systems in place with more support and we have to focus on quality so that all our kids have access to the best possible care.

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois
texte: I think it is absolutely essential.

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois
texte: And I want to say something else about it, when people talk to me about the need to improve our educations system, I agree, because I want every child to have the best possible education.

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois
texte: But education starts at birth.

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois
texte: Education starts when that little baby comes into the world.

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois
texte: In fact we now know, because of brain research, that about 80% of the brain is actually developed by the age of 3 and 4.

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois
texte: If we don't take care of our babies we are short changing them on their brain development and then when we get to kindergarten no matter how hard they try, no matter how much their mom says do your best, do your homework, no matter how hard their teacher works they're going to be at a disadvantage.

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois
texte: So yea, we're going to make sure that Charlotte has every chance in the world but I want every baby, everyone your babies and every baby you take care of to have exactly the same chances.

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois
texte: Ultimately, this is, for me, about how we work together to give every child the chance to live up to his or her God-given potential.

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois
texte: You see it in their faces when they are put in your arms from the very first minute.

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois
texte: You want to keep that light in their eyes, you want to make sure they have every opportunity to fulfill that God-given potential.

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks in Chicago, Illinois

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: Well, this is so exciting, to be here with all of you and to be here for such an important cause, to make sure that the Democratic Party and particularly the Democratic Women's Council recruits and trains and fields more women for public office right here in South Carolina.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: I was thinking on the way down here that I first came to South Carolina as a young lawyer working for the Children's Defense Fund, started by your own South Carolina native Marian Wright Edelman from Bennettsville.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: Made a lot of friends, had a lot of good times, and am thrilled to be back, and I'm back because I want to support you.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: You know, the theme of this day of events is how to build a party and how to build a party that really respects and includes women and gives women in this state a chance to not only be at the table but at the head of the table.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: Carrying with them their Democratic experiences and their life experiences.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: And you're right, I am running to live again at 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: But I don't want to be there all by myself—I want Democrats elected from the local to the county to the state to the federal level, once again making the case that when Democrats win, Americans win.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: I want to say just a few words about what's happening to America's families and what's happening with our economy.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: Because I've always believed fundamentally that when families are strong, America is strong.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: And we've come through some really tough economic times.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: I looked at the statistics and South Carolina has pulled itself up and other places have as well.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: American families have made a lot of sacrifices.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: People lost jobs, people lost homes, people had to put college on the back burner, retirement on the back burner.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: But everybody just kept going.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: It took a lot of determination, and across America we're beginning to see the results of all that hard work.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: And I will say that there does seem to be a pattern, Democratic presidents, and there are two in particular that I'm thinking of, over the last 35 years, seem to inherit a mess of problems.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: Have you noticed that?

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: So then they have to dig us out of the ditches they find themselves in and put us back on the right track, and of course I'm talking about Bill Clinton and Barrack Obama, but of course presidents don't do it alone—they do it with the American people.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: And today we are standing again, but we're not yet running.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: And we face a choice: Are we going to hand over our country once again to people and policies that crashed our economy before and that will shred all the progress we've made?

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: Well that's obviously the right answer, but that's what this campaign is going to be about.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: Because we're going to have to stand up to the people who want to keep the deck stacked in favor of those at the top.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: We are going to fight to make sure that the success of our country is shared across the economy and that more families have the chance to get ahead and not just to get by but to stay moving forward with the kind of confidence and optimism that has always marked the best times in America.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: It's time to make the words \middle class\" mean something again.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: They should represent a solemn promise that anyone willing to work hard can earn a decent living and a better life, not just get by paycheck to paycheck.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: That's the middle class I grew up in.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: My dad was a small businessman, and when I say small, it was small.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: He ran a small drapery printing business.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: And he literally had a print plant with big long tables that had silk screens, and sometimes my mother, my brothers, and I would help to pour the paint in and take the squeegee and then we'd walk down the table, print the fabrics, and then he'd go out and sell them.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: And it was a good decent middle-class life that he provided to my brothers and me.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: And I am so grateful, and there was never in my mind in fact that's what so many of us believed when we were growing up.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: The future seemed so unlimited—of course we had to fix a lot of things in the country, starting with civil rights and human rights, but the opportunity ladder always was held out there.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: I just came from Kiki's Chicken and Waffles, which I highly recommend, and I was meeting with a group of African American businesswomen, and they were telling me what they needed to keep growing and build an even better future, it sounded so much like the conversation I remember around my dinner table.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: That's what links us together past all the other differences that sometimes divide us.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: Being middle class in America should mean you feel in control of your own financial destiny.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: It should mean you have a little more, so you can worry a little less.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: It should mean that you can invest in your future and the future of your children, putting aside some for education, putting aside some for retirement.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: You should be able to go to sleep at night knowing that everything you've worked for won't be lost in a flash because of decisions that are made or failed to be made in Washington.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: So therefore, I want to be a president who makes corporations live up to the basic guarantee that when workers help produce record profits, those workers should get a real share of the rewards instead of it all going to those at the top.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: And you know the statistic.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: Something is wrong when top CEOs earn 300 times more than a typical American worker, or here is my latest least favorite statistic, the 25 biggest hedge fund managers earn more than all the kindergarten teachers in America...combined.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: What does that say about our values and the importance of preparing our children through education to make it in a very competitive global economy?

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: Today, too many politicians who want to return to the same failed top-down economics are mouthing the words \"middle class.\" But this is something you have to believe in and something you have to be ready to fight for.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: If those words are going to have meaning again, they've got to be backed up by real solutions, not empty rhetoric.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: And those solutions have to speak to the ways that the economy has changed.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: Today, 40 percent of mothers are the sole or primary breadwinners in their household.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: And more Americans are working multiple jobs just to make ends meet.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: Parents are rushing home from work to get their kids home from school and maybe get them off to practice or rehearsal.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: They are squeezing every minute out of a 24-hour day with barely enough time to breathe, let alone relax.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: I remember when I was a practicing lawyer back in Little Rock, and around 3 o'clock every afternoon all of the women who worked in the firm were hunched over their phones kind of whispering into them and at first I didn't know what was going on, and then I realized they were checking to see if their children got home safely.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: Many people today can't count on relatives to pitch in because so many families now are scattered across the country.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: Now I happen to be extremely lucky because my amazing 8-month-old granddaughter lives near me, so I get to see her a lot.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: But nobody expects everything to come easy, that's not part of life, we know that, but it shouldn't be quite so hard to get ahead and stay ahead.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: So I do believe that everyday Americans and their families need a champion.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: A champion who will fight for them every single day.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: Not for some Americans but for all Americans.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: And I want to be that champion.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: I want to get up every single day going to work for you, standing up for you, making a difference for you.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: Now, take the issue of equal pay.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: I don't think I'm letting you in on a secret when I say, too many women still earn less than men on the job.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: And women of color often make even less.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: And then there's the so called, motherhood penalty, with many women taking a pay cut when they have children.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: All this lost money adds up.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: For many families, we're talking about thousands of dollars every year.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: That's money that could go for rent or groceries or a new car or into the college fund.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: Now we could fix this.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: If Republicans would get on board, we in fact could fix this today but they won't.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: One Republican candidate dismissed equal pay as \"a bogus issue.\" Another said Congress was \"wasting time\" worrying about it.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: One even said that efforts to guarantee fair pay reminded him of the Soviet Union.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: And to that I say what century are they living in?

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: But thankfully the American people know the truth.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: And the truth is that when any parent is short-changed, the entire family is short-changed.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: And when families are short-changed, America is short-changed.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: And therefore this is not a women's issue this is a family issue and an American economic issue.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: And here's what we should do instead to close the wage gap.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: First, we should pass the Paycheck Fairness Act, which gives women the legal tools we need to fight discrimination at work.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: I introduced this legislation in the Senate back in 2005 and kept sponsoring it again and again.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: Well it's time to get this done, once and for all.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: Second, we should promote pay transparency across our economy to ensure women have the information they need to negotiate fairly.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: You can't stand up for equal pay if you don't know whether you're paid equally.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: You remember the Lilly Ledbetter case, she didn't know for the longest that she wasn't being paid the same as her male coworkers doing the same jobs.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: Postings for new jobs or promotions should come with salary ranges.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: Large companies should report on how fairly, or not, they're compensating workers, male or female.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: And we should applaud those businesses and communities that are leading the way with best practices and real accountability.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: I think transparency when it comes to pay is our friend.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: The more we can bring it out from under the table to put it on top, the more information we can have to advocate for ourselves and advocate for each other.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: Third, we need to raise wages for the lowest paid jobs in America -- which are, they are disproportionately held by women, especially women of color—we need to make it easier for more women to enter higher paying fields like science and engineering and technology.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: But I want to say something that a lot of people may not know even in this room full of activist and well informed democrats.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: In most states today, waitresses, bartenders, hairstylists, and others who rely on tips are paid even lower than minimum wage.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: Some are paid as little as two dollars and thirteen cents an hour.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina
texte: And they are also more likely to face exploitation, wage theft, and sexual harassment.

texte: Think about somebody you may know, think about the mom trying to succeed at work and give her kids the support they need with a job that pays her $2.13 an hour.

titre: Remarks to the Democratic Women's Council in Columbia, South Carolina

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: Growth and fairness go together.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: Is this possible in today's world?

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: Do I think it will be easy?

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: But, here's the good news: There are allies for change everywhere who know we can't stand by while inequality increases, wages stagnate, and the promise of America dims.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: We should welcome the support of all Americans who want to go forward together with us.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: Business leaders who want higher pay for employees, equal pay for women and no discrimination against the LGBT community either.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: There are union leaders who are investing their own pension funds in putting people to work to build tomorrow's economy.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: We need everyone to come to the table and work with us.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: In the coming weeks, I'll propose specific policies to: Reward businesses who invest in long term value rather than the quick buck — because that leads to higher growth for the economy, higher wages for workers, and yes, bigger profits, everybody will have a better time.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: I will rewrite the tax code so it rewards hard work and investments here at home, not quick trades or stashing profits overseas.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: I will give new incentives to companies that give their employees a fair share of the profits their hard work earns.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: We will unleash a new generation of entrepreneurs and small business owners by providing tax relief, cutting red tape, and making it easier to get a small business loan.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: We will restore America to the cutting edge of innovation, science, and research by increasing both public and private investments.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: And we will make America the clean energy superpower of the 21st century.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: Developing renewable power — wind, solar, advanced biofuels... Building cleaner power plants, smarter electric grids, greener buildings...

And ease the transition for distressed communities to a more diverse and sustainable economic future from coal country to Indian country, from small towns in the Mississippi Delta to the Rio Grande Valley to our inner cities, we have to help our fellow Americans.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: Now, this will create millions of jobs and countless new businesses, and enable America to lead the global fight against climate change.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: We will also connect workers to their jobs and businesses.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: Customers will have a better chance to actually get where they need and get what they desire with roads, railways, bridges, airports, ports, and broadband brought up to global standards for the 21st century.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: We will establish an infrastructure bank and sell bonds to pay for some of these improvements.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: Now, building an economy for tomorrow also requires investing in our most important asset, our people, beginning with our youngest.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: Too many of our kids never have the chance to learn and thrive as they should and as we need them to.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: Our country won't be competitive or fair if we don't help more families give their kids the best possible start in life.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: So let's staff our primary and secondary schools with teachers who are second to none in the world, and receive the respect they deserve for sparking the love of learning in every child.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: Let's make college affordable and available to all ...and lift the crushing burden of student debt.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: Let's provide lifelong learning for workers to gain or improve skills the economy requires, setting up many more Americans for success.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: Now, the second fight is to strengthen America's families, because when our families are strong, America is strong.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: And today's families face new and unique pressures.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: Parents need more support and flexibility to do their job at work and at home.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: I believe you should have the right to earn paid sick days.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: I believe you should receive your work schedule with enough notice to arrange childcare or take college courses to get ahead.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: I believe you should look forward to retirement with confidence, not anxiety.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: That you should have the peace of mind that your health care will be there when you need it, without breaking the bank.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: I believe we should offer paid family leave so no one has to choose between keeping a paycheck and caring for a new baby or a sick relative.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: And it is way past time to end the outrage of so many women still earning less than men on the job — and women of color often making even less.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: This isn't a women's issue.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: In America, every family should feel like they belong.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: So we should offer hard-working, law-abiding immigrant families a path to citizenship.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: Not second-class status.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: And, we should ban discrimination against LGBT Americans and their families so they can live, learn, marry, and work just like everybody else.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: You know, America's diversity, our openness, our devotion to human rights and freedom is what's drawn so many to our shores.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: What's inspired people all over the world.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: I've seen it with my own eyes.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: And these are also qualities that prepare us well for the demands of a world that is more interconnected than ever before.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: So we have a third fight: to harness all of America's power, smarts, and values to maintain our leadership for peace, security, and prosperity.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: No other country on Earth is better positioned to thrive in the 21st century.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: No other country is better equipped to meet traditional threats from countries like Russia, North Korea, and Iran — and to deal with the rise of new powers like China.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: No other country is better prepared to meet emerging threats from cyber attacks, transnational terror networks like ISIS, and diseases that spread across oceans and continents.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: As your President, I'll do whatever it takes to keep Americans safe.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: And if you look over my left shoulder you can see the new World Trade Center soaring skyward.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: As a Senator from New York, I dedicated myself to getting our city and state the help we needed to recover.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"

texte: But, I know — I know we have to be smart as well as strong.

texte: There are a lot of trouble spots in the world, but there's a lot of good news out there too.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: I believe the future holds far more opportunities than threats if we exercise creative and confident leadership that enables us to shape global events rather than be shaped by them.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: And we all know that in order to be strong in the world, though, we first have to be strong at home.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: That's why we have to win the fourth fight — reforming our government and revitalizing our democracy so that it works for everyday Americans.

texte: We need Justices on the Supreme Court who will protect every citizen's right to vote, rather than every corporation's right to buy elections.

texte: If necessary, I will support a constitutional amendment to undo the Supreme Court's decision in Citizens United.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: I want to make it easier for every citizen to vote.

texte: That's why I've proposed universal, automatic registration and expanded early voting.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: I'll fight back against Republican efforts to disempower and disenfranchise young people, poor people, people with disabilities, and people of color.

texte: What part of democracy are they afraid of?

texte: No matter how easy we make it to vote, we still have to give Americans something worth voting for.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: Government is never going to have all the answers — but it has to be smarter, simpler, more efficient, and a better partner.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: We need expertise and innovation from the private sector to help cut waste and streamline services.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: There's so much that works in America.

texte: I want to help Washington catch up.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: To do that, we need a political system that produces results by solving problems that hold us back, not one overwhelmed by extreme partisanship and inflexibility.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: Now, I'll always seek common ground with friend and opponent alike.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: But I'll also stand my ground when I must.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: That's something I did as Senator and Secretary of State — whether it was working with Republicans to expand health care for children and for our National Guard, or improve our foster care and adoption system, or pass a treaty to reduce the number of Russian nuclear warheads that could threaten our cities — and it's something I will always do as your President.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: We Americans may differ, bicker, stumble, and fall; but we are at our best when we pick each other up, when we have each other's back.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: Like any family, our American family is strongest when we cherish what we have in common, and fight back against those who would drive us apart.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: People all over the world have asked me: \"How could you and President Obama work together after you fought so hard against each other in that long campaign?\" Now, that is an understandable question considering that in many places, if you lose an election you could get imprisoned or exiled — even killed — not hired as Secretary of State.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: But President Obama asked me to serve, and I accepted because we both love our country.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: That's how we do it in America.

texte: With that same spirit, together, we can win these four fights.

texte: We can build an economy where hard work is rewarded.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: We can strengthen our families.

titre: Remarks in a Campaign \Kickoff\" Speech in New York City"
texte: We can defend our country and increase our opportunities all over the world.

texte: And we can renew the promise of our democracy.

texte: It's no secret that we're going up against some pretty powerful forces that will do and spend whatever it takes to advance a very different vision for America.

texte: You know, I know how hard this job is.

texte: So I'm looking forward to a great debate among Democrats, Republicans, and Independents.

texte: Like so much else in my life, I got this from my mother.

texte: When I was a girl, she never let me back down from any bully or barrier.

texte: This is, for me, a very important place to be to talk about a really critical issue, one that, as Julie has said, I have spent much of my adult life being committed to and concerned about, and I can't think of a better place to do this than here in New Hampshire, a state that will always have a special place in my heart.

titre: Remarks and a Question and Answer Session at a Campaign Event in Rochester, New Hampshire
texte: And so, I had a great event Saturday in a perfect place on a perfect day, on Roosevelt Island in New York City at the Four Freedoms park that was constructed in honor of President Roosevelt.

titre: Remarks and a Question and Answer Session at a Campaign Event in Rochester, New Hampshire
texte: And I was able to talk about the four fights that I want to wage and win on behalf of the American people.

titre: Remarks and a Question and Answer Session at a Campaign Event in Rochester, New Hampshire
texte: And I will be rolling out specific policies over the weeks to come, but I do believe with all my heart that everything we need to do in our country really starts with how we treat our children and how we try to raise them, taking care of their needs, being able to stimulate them, to give them a better chance in life, helping them become successful and good citizens.

titre: Remarks and a Question and Answer Session at a Campaign Event in Rochester, New Hampshire
