titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: We're joined right off the bat by Democratic candidate for president and former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: Madam Secretary, thanks so much for joining us.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: On Saturday, you called for new sanctions against Iran for its ballistic missile program.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: That prompted a response from another American who was once held prisoner in Iran, Shane Bauer, one of the hikers released in 2011.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: He had some tough words for you on Twitter, writing—quote—\Seriously, why would Hillary call for more sanctions now?

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: As far as we know, four of the Americans are still in Iran.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: Totally irresponsible\"—unquote.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: He also said, whenever he was in Iran, whenever he heard your voice, his heart would sink, because—quote—\"All she ever does with Iran is inflame tensions.\" I want to give you awe chance to respond.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: Well, look, I appreciate what he went through when he was held prisoner in the infamous Iranian prison.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: And we were very happy that we were able to get him and the two other hikers back home.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: But we have a very clear path we are pursuing with Iran.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: I am pleased that we do have an agreement that is being implemented.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: And I was part of putting that in place by getting the sanctions imposed on Iran that the entire world went along with.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: But we also have made it clear from the beginning that their missile activity is still subject to sanction.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: That is part of the overall approach that the administration has taken toward Iran, and that I support.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: So, when we became aware of missile activity that is under U.N. supervision and is prohibited, it would be a mistake not to make clear to Iran that we are very, very happy to see us implementing the agreement to put a lid on the nuclear weapons program and the way that they have complied, but that doesn't mean they can now go off and invest and test a lot of missiles that would eventually be able to be intercontinental that could reach the United States and maybe carry a very dangerous weapon.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: So, I think there might be a misunderstanding of what our whole agreement consists of, because, certainly, I have made clear I'm proud of the role that I played in getting that agreement in place, but, as president, I will enforce it.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: And there have to be consequences if Iran veers away from what it has agreed to or what it has been mandated to do or prohibited from doing by the international community.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: Well, I don't know anything about it, but I have released my medical records.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: And I remember being asked frequently for me to do so.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: And, so, obviously that's, you know, something I will leave up to the Sanders campaign.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: But this is a spirited debate, because, although we share some very similar goals for our country, we have differences.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: And Senator Sanders has been pointing them out.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: One of my biggest differences has been on guns.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: And I'm very pleased that he flip-flopped on the immunity legislation.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: Now I hope he will flip-flop on what we call the Charleston loophole, and join legislation to close that, because it's been a key argument of my campaign that we Democrats, in fact, Americans need to stand up to the gun lobby and pass comprehensive commonsense gun measures that will make America safer.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: And that's what I intend to do.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: Single-payer would have lower costs.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: And one of the reasons that the president has a provision in his approach that guarantees states can go single-payer is to permit states that are able to do that to start down the single-payer road.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: Well, I believe in universal health care.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: And I think we have now, finally, after many decades of efforts, thanks to President Obama, a plan that will get us to universal health care.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: It's the Affordable Care Act.

titre: Interview with Jake tapper of CNN's \State of the Union\""
texte: So, I'm not interested in what the Republicans are trying to do, which is to repeal it, as they consistently vote to do.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: Well, I think you know the answer, because they know that I say what I mean, I do what I say I will do, and I know how to get it done, to take after them, to prevent them from——pushing an agenda on us that hurts the economy.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: Now, another area where I have very strong feelings and share exactly the same goal as Senator Sanders is health care.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: You know, I believe in universal health care coverage.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: Every American should have it.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: You know, before it was called Obamacare it was called Hillarycare back in '93 and '94 when I was trying to get universal health care, and we were not successful.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: And that was really disappointing.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: I mean, the drug companies, the insurance companies spent millions of dollars against us.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: So we didn't succeed.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: And then I got to thinking, well, what can I do now?

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: Because, you know, my view is when you're knocked down, you share the human experience because everybody gets knocked down about something.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: The real question is whether you get back up.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: So I started thinking, what can I do that can help somebody make a difference in their lives.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: And I remembered when I was traveling around the country trying to get universal health care, meeting so many people who did not have health insurance, they couldn't afford it, they had a pre-existing condition and the insurance companies wouldn't give it to them.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: And I met so many really good, decent people who are so overwhelmed by what was happening to them.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: And I remember I was at the Children's Hospital in Cleveland.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: I was meeting with a group of parents whose kids were really sick with chronic diseases.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: And one man said to me, he said, \"You know, I've gone everywhere to try to get insurance for my daughters.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: I have two girls with cystic fibrosis, and nobody will sell it to me.\" I said what do they say when you go ask them and you tell them you want to try to pay for something?

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: He said, I'll tell you what the last person told me at the insurance company I visited.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: He said, we don't insure burning houses.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: This man said, they called my little girls burning houses.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: And that stuck with me, that and the stories I heard.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: So I started to work with Democrats and Republicans and we created the Children's Health Insurance Program, and it now insures eight million kids because when you get——you encounter an obstacle, you run into a problem, you've got to keep going.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: You can't ever stop if you're trying to accomplish something that will help other people.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: And I was thrilled when the president passed and signed the Affordable Care Act.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: We've been trying to get that—the Democratic party has been trying to get that accomplished since Harry Truman.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: And now, I meet people all the time who are benefiting from it.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: I want to build on it and I want to improve it.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: You know, the Republicans want to repeal it, and that's what they'll do if they get the White House back.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: We can't let that happen.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: Here is what I want to do.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: I want to decrease costs, out-of-pocket costs; decrease prescription drug costs.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: I want to make sure that we get the authority for Medicare to negotiate for lower drug costs with the drug companies.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: I want to go after the predatory pricing that drug companies are using to raise the price of drugs.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: I want to take away their tax benefits.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: They actually get a tax benefit for advertising all that stuff on TV to us that we never—I can't understand what they're talking about.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: They have people walking through fields of wildflowers, walking on beaches.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: I mean, it——drives you crazy.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: And they spend more money advertising on TV than they spend on research.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: So we're going to go right at them.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: We're going to take them on on this.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: That's the disagreement I have with Senator Sanders.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: I want us to build on what we have and make it better, and go from 90 percent coverage to 100 percent of Americans.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: I don't want to start at zero and have to——fight it all over again, have to have the national battle we that we had on health care over the last 25 years.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: So I'm determined that we're going to make this work for everybody, and I know it's the right thing to do.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: And I hope that, you know, we will be able to get your costs down, your co-pays, your deductibles, what, you know, a lot of people are telling me are starting to pinch again.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: I also will defend Social Security against privatization.

texte: The Republicans still want to privatize it.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: They're still talking about that.

texte: It's a terrible idea.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: And you know the worst part of the idea is they want to turn the entire Social Security trust fund over to Wall Street.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: That's what this is all about.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: Take all that money that people have been paying in for, you know, 75, 80 years and turn it over to Wall Street.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: I will never let that happen.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: That is the worst——idea that is imaginable.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: I will also not let them voucherize Medicare, something else they want to do, and I will not let them privatize the VA. We have to fix the VA, but we are not going to take away guaranteed benefits from our veterans who have earned them through their service.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: That's not going to happen.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: And when it comes to foreign policy and national security, well, I think we have a lot to do to keep our country safe, and I have some ideas that I've been putting out based on what I did in the Senate after 9/11, based on my work as secretary of State.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: It's imperative that we do everything we can to defeat ISIS, to stop the flow of foreign fighters and funding to fight them on the Internet where they're quite effective without putting American troops back on the ground in either Syria or Iraq.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: That will not happen.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: It's not—it's not going to happen on my watch.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: And then we have to do a better job working with federal, state, and local law enforcement to keep us safe at home, and we have to do a better job sharing intelligence, getting intelligence that will help us prevent attacks.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: When I was a senator after 9/11, I'd be kept up-to-date on all the threats that still were facing New York, and we had a very, very dedicated group of police and federal law enforcement and everyone who worked together.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: But, you know, one of the best things we did was a campaign which said, If you see something suspicious or you hear something suspicious, report it.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: And so people were picking up the phone and telling the police or maybe calling the FBI, and it really provided kind of the—the eyes-on help that we needed.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: And people could then follow up, and we prevented attacks.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: Well, the reason I mention that is because of this.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: The Republican candidates, led by their frontrunner, have been attacking Muslims, right?

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: You've heard that, attacking American Muslims, attacking Muslims around the world.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: That's not only shameful, it's dangerous.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: We need everybody in this country to be on the same team when it comes to preventing terrorist attacks.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: And we need people who are in the community who hear something, see something to report it and not feel like they're being demonized, defamed, insulted, pushed out.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: And certainly, if we're going to defeat ISIS, we need a coalition that includes Muslim nations.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: Now, I can tell you I built the coalition that imposed sanctions on Iran.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: I know a little bit about how you do this.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: You don't start by insulting people's religion and then ask them to be part of your effort to defeat a common adversary.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: That's not the way it works in the real world.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: So we have to be smart about how we protect ourselves, and that will be my highest priority.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: I also want to continue to move toward comprehensive immigration reform, which I think is in the best interest of our country and our economy.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: And I want to let you know where I stand on a lot of the issues that the Republicans have taken positions on because they seem to be against so many of the fundamental rights that I support.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: I am for a woman's right—a woman's right to make her own health decisions, and I am against defunding Planned Parenthood.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: And I would do everything I can to reverse that decision.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: I also want to keep pushing for criminal justice reform and reform in the incarceration system.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: And I want to fight for common sense gun safety measures that will help keep— —Americans safe without infringing on gun owners' rights.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: We are a smart—we are a smart people.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: And what I don't understand is how when we know we have, on average, 90 people a day dying from gun violence, 33,000 people a year, we cannot figure out how to protect people, protect first-graders going to school, people going to a movie theater, churchgoers going to Bible study.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: We can't stop every murder or every suicide or every tragic, avoidable accident, but we can stop a lot of them without infringing on anybody's rights.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: And 92 percent of the American people agree with that, and 85 percent of gun owners agree with that.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: So we need somebody who will stand up to the gun lobby and stop them from intimidating common sense reforms in our country.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: So we have a lot of work to do, my friends.

texte: And you have been really patient.

texte: I am all about working with people.

titre: Remarks at a Campaign Rally in Marshalltown, Iowa
texte: You had to work for it, but if you did, you could get ahead and stay ahead.

texte: And I think the people in Iowa want to go to the caucuses thinking about which one of us as president can actually make a difference in their lives, and that's the case I've been focused on making.

texte: I mean, honestly, I've been standing up and fighting and getting knocked around for years, trying to get things done that I think would improve people's lives.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: And I'm not going to stop, and that includes anybody trying to, you know, mess with our financial system.

texte: And I know that I have the best plan to rein in Wall Street abuses, to make sure it doesn't ever happen again.

texte: And let's take health care as an example.

texte: You know, we've been trying, as Democrats, since Harry Truman to get on the path to universal coverage.

texte: Before it was called \Obama care,\" it was called \"Hillary care,\" and I have the scars to prove it.

texte: And I was thrilled when President Obama passed and signed the Affordable Care Act.

titre: Interview with Alisyn Camerota of CNN's \New Day\""

titre: Interview with Alisyn Camerota of CNN's \New Day\""

titre: Interview with Alisyn Camerota of CNN's \New Day\""

titre: Interview with Alisyn Camerota of CNN's \New Day\""
texte: I know how to do this and I'm ready.

titre: Interview with Alisyn Camerota of CNN's \New Day\""
texte: I'm experienced and I think I have got the best shot at becoming both the nominee and the next president.

titre: Interview with Alisyn Camerota of CNN's \New Day\""

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: Well, what do you say we talk to Hillary Clinton, who's good enough to join us this morning on a very important and busy day.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: Thank you so much for doing that.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: And so do you have the victory party all set for tonight?

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: Well, this is a very tight race, Robin.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: It's really going down to the wire.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: But we feel very good, we've worked so hard.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: I've had a great operation here.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: So many young people, organizers who fanned out across the state, the thousands of volunteers.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: We did knock on 125,000 doors this past weekend.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: So we're very committed, very energized and enthusiastic, but it all depends upon who shows up tonight, who comes out to caucus in Iowa.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: And I'm urging everyone who is interested in, committed to caucusing for me to please be there tonight, 6:30.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: I will be there in spirit, because if you stand up for me, I will stand up for you during this campaign and into the White House.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: Well, I think that I have a much better organization, to be just really clear about it.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: I think that we built an organization using a lot of the lessons learned, and we recruited some of the best people that you could find anywhere in the country working in Democratic politics.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: I think I'm a better candidate.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: I think that in addition to just knowing more about the caucus process and what we needed to do to build toward this night.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: My experience as secretary of State really deepened and intensified my understanding about what the next president will have to face.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: So all in all, I feel like it's a different energized effort that is really bringing in people from across the state and, indeed, across the country who know what's at stake in this election, understand how really dramatic and drastic it would be if the Republicans were to take back the White House because they would rip out the progress.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: We wouldn't be able to, in my view, get the economy going for everybody, get incomes rising, get affordable college, take care of the rising prescription drug costs, everything I'm talking about, which is really in response to the concerns and the worries that I hear from people as I criss-cross this state.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: Well, I haven't gotten to all 99.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: I had to — let's just say that.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: I don't want anybody to think that my silence is affirmation.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: But I've covered a lot of ground and I sure have met many thousands of people and have really learned so much.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: You know, that's the best part of this.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: It's obviously exhausting, it takes a lot of concentration.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: But what keeps me going are the stories that people tell me.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: There's something so intimate, at least in my experience because I actually try to listen to people and hear what's on their minds when someone tells you about the open heart surgery that their granddaughter had to have as a baby and how they couldn't have afforded it without the Affordable Care Act, or when a young woman says she's just drowning in student debt and needs a way out, that sticks with me.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: And I think that the months I've spent here listening to Iowans has really made me a better candidate and I think it will make me a better president.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: That's a — that's a really great question, and thanks for asking it because I get asked that a lot.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: You know, I have a record of working with Republicans.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: When I'm actually in a position to do so — when, you know, there's a campaign, it's a little bit different — but when I was first lady, I worked to achieve the Children's Health Insurance Program, working across the aisle with both Republicans and Democrats, even reformed our foster care and adoption system, teaming up with Tom DeLay, a very partisan Republican in the House.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: And when I got to the Senate, I worked hard to get health care for the National Guard and Reserves, I worked with Senator Lindsey Graham in that case.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: And I — I don't know that there was a single Republican who didn't co-sponsor one of the bills that I worked on.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: And as secretary of State, I had similar efforts to reach common ground that proved successful.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: I know in a campaign that distinctions have to be drawn because we have to give voters a real sense of what each of us wants to do, and to hold us accountable for the agenda we put forth.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: But I am confident that I'm going to work really hard to find that common ground across the aisle, and we will make progress together.

titre: Interview with Robin Roberts and Jonathan Karl of ABC's \Good Morning America\""
texte: Great to talk to you.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: An unbelievable night.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: What a great campaign.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: This has been an incredible honor to campaign across Iowa, with so many of you to make the case for the kind of future we want.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: For the Democratic Party and for the United States of America.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: There is so much at stake in this election, I don't need to tell you.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: Every single one of you who came out for me, who worked so many hours — from my young organizers with energy and passion to the families and friends across this state — I am deeply grateful.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: Here's what I want you to know.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: It is rare that we have the opportunity we do now, to have a real contest of ideas.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: To really think hard about what the Democratic Party stands for and what we want the future of our country to look like if we do our part to build it.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: I am a progressive who gets things done for people.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: I am honored to stand in the long line of American reformers who make up our minds that the status quo is not good enough.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: That standing still is not an option.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: And that brings people together to find ways forward that will improve the lives of Americans.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: I look back over the years of my involvement from the very first job I had at the Children's Defense Fund.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: I know what we are capable of doing, I know we can create more good paying jobs and raise incomes for hardworking Americans again.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: I know that we can finish the job of universal health care coverage for every single man, woman, and child.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: I know we can combat climate change and be the clean energy superpower of the 21st century.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: I know we can make our education system work for every one of our children, especially those who come with disadvantages.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: I know we can make college affordable and get student debt off the backs of young people.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: And I know we can protect our rights, women's rights, gay rights, voting rights, immigrant rights, workers rights.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: I know too we can stand up to the gun lobby and get common sense gun safety measures.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: And how do we do that?

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: We do that by securing the nomination, and then we do it by winning and going into that White House as others before have, determined to push forward on the great goals and values that unite us as Americans.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: I congratulate my esteemed friends and opponents; I wish Governor O'Malley the very best.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: He is a great public servant who has served Maryland and our country and I am excited about really getting into the debate with Senator Sanders about the best way forward to fight for us and America.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: In the last few weeks, we finally began to have what I think is one of the most important substantive conversations that the Democratic party could have.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: And I am thrilled at all of the people who are playing a part in that.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: I know that we may have differences of opinion about how best to achieve our goals.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: But I believe we have a very clear idea that the Democratic Party and this campaign stands for what is best in America.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: And we have to be united.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: When it is all said and done, we have to be united.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: A Republican vision and candidates that would drive us apart and divide us.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: That is not who we are, my friends.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: I follow their candidates very closely, I understand what they're appealing to, and I intend to stand against it.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: I will not — I will not let their decisiveness, their efforts to rip away the progress that we've made, be successful.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: Because we can't afford that.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: As I stand here tonight, breathing a big sigh of relief, thank you, Iowa.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: I want you to know, I will keep doing what I have done my entire life.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: I will keep standing up for you.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: I will keep fighting for you.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: I will always work to achieve the America that I believe in, where the promise of that dream that we hold out to our children and our grandchildren never fades, but inspires generations to come.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: Join me, let's go win the nomination.

titre: Remarks in Des Moines Following the Iowa Caucus
texte: Thank you all and God bless you.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: The breaking news this hour.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: Hillary Clinton has been declared the winner of the Iowa caucuses.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: She beat Bernie Sanders by a razor-thin margin just 0.2 of a percentage point.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: Her campaign claimed victory overnight but the Iowa Democratic Party has just issued the final results.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: They say Hillary Clinton is the winner of the Iowa caucuses.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: And Secretary Clinton is joining us now from Nashua, New Hampshire.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: Madam Secretary, thanks very much for joining us.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: What's your reaction to the official results now declaring you the winner of the Iowa caucuses?

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: I am so thrilled, Wolf.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: I feel really good and very grateful to the team I had on the ground, to the tens of thousands of Iowans who volunteered, knocked on doors, came out and caucused last night.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: And I could feel the energy building in the weeks leading up to the caucus.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: I was out there, making my case about what I want to do and what I think our country must do to get real results with more jobs, rising incomes, build on the Affordable Care Act, deal with climate change, clean energy, defend our rights, all the things I feel passionate about.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: And I could just watch and, in fact, in that last week I had so many people come up to me and say that they had decided to support me and it could not have been better.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: It was a great, great night.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: Well, as you recall, my luck was not that good last time around.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: And it was wonderful to win the caucus and to have that experience of all the hard work, the grassroots organizing pay off the way it did.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: Now we're here in New Hampshire and we are going to have a contest of ideas.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: I'm looking forward to the forum tomorrow night on CNN and then a debate Thursday night, here in New Hampshire, because I think that Democratic voters and other Americans want to know what are the principal differences between me and my friend and opponent, Senator Sanders.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: And I want to get that information out there.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: I think it's important people understand that good ideas are one thing but you got to know how to implement.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: You've got to have a record of getting results.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: And I'm taking my ideas and my record to the people of New Hampshire this week.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: Well, you know, Wolf, this is really hard to follow because, when we said we would do the debate, they came back with conditions.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: We met the conditions.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: Then they said they want different conditions.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: And we've tried to be very accommodating but, you know, we have agreed with everything that they have asked us to do.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: And I sure hope — we're in Bernie Sanders' backyard here in New Hampshire.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: I sure hope he intends to show up in his neighboring state and let the people of New Hampshire see us both on the debate stage.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: We've accepted all of their conditions.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: We did that last week.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: And they keep trying to add new conditions, which, you know, raises questions about how ready or willing they are to debate here in New Hampshire.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: We met their conditions.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: We agreed to more debates, something that I wanted to do because I think it's great to debate and we're ready.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: I'm going to be there Thursday night.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: You know, look, I — they — I can say that I believe the Democratic Party of Iowa ran a good caucus from everything that our people told me.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: There was an enormous turnout, which everybody said would tremendously favor Senator Sanders.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: If there are legitimate issues, both sides, I don't think the Democratic Party has any problems with that.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: But from everything we have learned and know, I won and I'm very proud of that.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: Well, I think it's certainly what I'm aiming for.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: I care a lot about this state.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: I view it as being the first-in-the-nation primary for a reason.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: I know that they tend to favor their neighbors.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: That's the pattern, the history of the primary.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: And Senator Sanders is a neighbor.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: But I think we will have a good contest, talking about what results we can produce, what our records have been, both in domestic policy, foreign policy, national security and I think the people of New Hampshire will get a chance to really evaluate both of us.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: And I feel good about my prospects.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: I'm talking about my record.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: I'm talking about the Children's Health Insurance Program for 8 million kids.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: I'm talking about getting health care for National Guard members.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: I'm talking about helping to push through a treaty to lower nuclear weapons between us and the Russians when I was secretary of state.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: I'm talking about building the coalition against Iran to bring them to the negotiating table and so many other issues.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: I have a very long record of getting results for people.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: That's what I care about.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: You know, I am all for laying out our ideology, talking about our ideas.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: I think that's great and it gives you the direction that you want to head.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: But at the end of the day, what matters to me is that we move our country forward.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: We actually get more good jobs with rising incomes.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: We get equal pay for women.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: We actually begin to move toward early childhood education and paid family leave.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: And we are ready to really go into the rest of the 21st century with the kind of confidence and optimism that I think our country should be having.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: So I'm going to lay out my record, lay out my ideas and Senator Sanders can certainly lay out his own and we'll leave it up to the people of New Hampshire to decide what they think is the best choice for them and their families and the results they want to see for themselves in our country.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: I'm thrilled to see so many young people get into the political process and I was very proud of all the young people who worked for me, volunteered for me, supported me.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: That's all to the good and it's great for the Democratic Party.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: But I'm going to have some work to do to reach out to young voters, maybe first-time voters, who have to make a tough decision as they evaluate who should be our president, our commander in chief, and I intend to do that, laying out my case, where we contrast on the issues, what I think can be done to get college to be affordable.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: I think my plan is going to really help the people who need it most without ballooning costs.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: I'm going to set forth my plan to refinance student debt, a problem I hear throughout New Hampshire and the country and why I think my plan will help more young people really get started with their lives.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: The emphasis I want to make on small business, my call that young people join our campaign and then be part of making us the clean energy superpower of the 21st century.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: And let's defend our rights.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: I am very proud that I got the endorsement of the Planned Parenthood Action Fund, that I got the endorsement of the Human Rights Campaign, that I got the endorsement of The Brady Campaign and Gabby Giffords and Mark Kelly and so many others, because they know me and they know what I have done.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: They know the kind of leader I am.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: And I want young people to know that as well.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: You know, Wolf, I'm not thinking that far ahead.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: My timeframe is next Tuesday and the primary in New Hampshire and then I'll go on to the caucuses in Nevada and the primary at the end of the month in South Carolina and then to the states that lie ahead.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: I'm going let the Republicans, you know, decide who their nominee will be.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: I will be prepared to run against and win, no matter who they nominate.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: I think, as everybody is well aware, I am pretty battle tested.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: It's important to have gone through this, to know what the Republicans will do.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: They're already running $6 million of ads against me along with their, you know, Wall Street buddies.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: And so they know who they don't want to be the Democratic nominee.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: And I take that as perversely flattering because they also know that I mean what I say and I'll do what I have said, to make sure that they don't ever wreck our economy again.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: So I'm going take them on as I have over the years and then, when I win, I will certainly reach out, work with them and find common ground wherever we can.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: Thank you so much, Wolf.

titre: Interview with Wolf Blitzer of CNN
texte: Great to talk to you again.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: Madam Secretary, thank you for joining us.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: It was quite a night last night and I was taken with your moment of candor there before the cameras when you said, you had a sigh of relief.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: Tell us about that sigh of relief and what it meant to you.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: Oh, Chris, it meant the world to me.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: As we all remember, I was not successful in Iowa last time and I know how hard that caucus process is.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: So proud of our organization, our volunteers, all my supporters.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: Everybody said if there were a big turnout, that would advantage Senator Sanders.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: There was a big turnout, and we won.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: And now I'm in New Hampshire looking forward to the primary next Tuesday and continuing to make my case in this contest of ideas between me and the senator.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: Look, Chris, I really believe that during the last few weeks leading up to the caucus, I could feel the energy building.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: It's a tough process and what I was seeing on the ground as people were telling me they were changing their minds, that they were supporting me, what my organizers were reporting, was all consistent that it was going to be close, but if we did our work, and we did, we would win.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: So I was thrilled by winning and getting that boost out of Iowa here in New Hampshire where I am in Senator Sanders' backyard, as you know, as a political expert of your many years, that New Hampshire votes for neighbors.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: And so I have to really get out there, make my case, which I intend to do this week.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: I feel really good about my campaign in New Hampshire and I remember getting off the plane in New Hampshire after the Iowa caucuses last time where I did not win, and I was way behind going into what was then just five days before the primary.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: And the work that was done on my behalf, the people who came out to support me, the incredible excitement — I saw that today in Nashua.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: I got here, it was amazing, Chris.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: The level of enthusiasm, people who were with me before, people who were with President Obama in '08, everybody working so hard to support me, to get to that primary, to do everything we possibly can.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: We're not leaving anything on the ground.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: We're moving forward.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: And I think we'll do well.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: I'm going to do everything I can to get out there, to meet with folks here, to answer their questions.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: I'm really happy we've got a forum on CNN tomorrow night.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: We've got your MSNBC debate on Thursday night, which will give us a chance to reach a larger audience.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: But I'm going to be there day after day between now and Tuesday.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: I respect this primary process.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC
texte: I know how seriously people take it.

titre: Interview with Chris Matthews of MSNBC

texte: We now begin a great national conversation about economic renewal for America.

texte: When we were governed by an America First policy, Detroit was booming.

texte: When we abandoned the policy of America First, we started rebuilding other countries instead of our own.

titre: Remarks at Aston Community Center in Aston, Pennsylvania

titre: Remarks at Aston Community Center in Aston, Pennsylvania

titre: Remarks at Aston Community Center in Aston, Pennsylvania

titre: Remarks at Aston Community Center in Aston, Pennsylvania

titre: Remarks at Aston Community Center in Aston, Pennsylvania

titre: Remarks at Aston Community Center in Aston, Pennsylvania

titre: Remarks at Aston Community Center in Aston, Pennsylvania

texte: We Will Make America Wealthy Again.
