texte: Then he hires people one hours work, I'm going to pay you the same.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: And those who started earlier in the day said hold on, we don't like this, that you're treating everybody who came late just as well as you're treating us.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: I'm going to tell you something, here's what I've come to know so well about Hillary.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: The team that she has assembled over the years of people that are so deeply loyal to her because she's so deeply loyal to them is inspiring.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: But I've seen that same degree of loyalty and compassion and sensitivity extended to the most recent folks who have joined the team, the folks who came to the vineyard with just one hour to go.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: Her loyalty and compassion of Hillary and Bill to people, if you're with you you're with you.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: And that is just something so remarkable.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: And finally, I'm proud of Hillary because she loves this country.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: Nobody — nobody had to wonder about Hillary Clinton, whether she would accept an outcome of an election in our beautiful democracy.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: Nobody had to ask that question.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: Nobody had to doubt it.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: She knows our country for what it is.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: She knows the system that we have and its warts and blemishes.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: She's deeply in love with it and accepts it.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: She's been in battles before where if it didn't go her way she accepted it, but then woke up the next day and battled again for the dreams that she's held fast to.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: And that love of country is something that I think is obvious to everybody, obvious to everyone.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: I want to thank Hillary Clinton for asking Anne and I to join this wild ride.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: We — about a week before she asked if I would be her running mate, Anne and I went up to Westchester and we sat down with Hillary and Bill and with Chelsea and Mark and with Charlotte and Aiden for about three hours of conversation to try to determine whether we would be the right people to be on the ticket.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: And when we got in the car to head back to the airport after the three hour discussion, I said to Anne, \"Honey, I don't know whether we're going to be on this ticket or not, but I do know this, we're going to remember that three hours for the rest of our life.\" And now, we've — we'll remember 105 days that we've had with this fantastic couple of public servants and all of you for the rest of our life.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: Hillary and I know well the wisdom and the words of William Faulkner.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: He said, \"They kilt us but they ain't whupped us yet.\" \"They kilt us but they ain't whupped us yet,\" because we know that the work remains.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: We know that the dreams of empowering families and children remain.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: And in that work, that important work that we have to do as a nation, it is so comforting even at a tough time to know that Hillary Clinton is somebody until her very last breath is going to be battling for the values that make this nation great and the values that we care so deeply about.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: So now, please join me in welcoming Secretary Hillary Rodham Clinton.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: Thank you all very much.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: Thank you, my friends.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: Thank you, thank you so very much for being here and I love you all, too.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: Last night, I congratulated Donald Trump and offered to work with him on behalf of our country.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: I hope that he will be a successful president for all Americans.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: This is not the outcome we wanted or we worked so hard for and I'm sorry that we did not win this election for the values we share and the vision we hold for our country.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: But I feel pride and gratitude for this wonderful campaign that we built together, this vast, diverse, creative, unruly, energized campaign.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: You represent the best of America and being your candidate has been one of the greatest honors of my life.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: I know how disappointed you feel because I feel it too, and so do tens of millions of Americans who invested their hopes and dreams in this effort.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: This is painful and it will be for a long time, but I want you to remember this.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: Our campaign was never about one person or even one election, it was about the country we love and about building an America that's hopeful, inclusive and big-hearted.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: We have seen that our nation is more deeply divided than we thought.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: But I still believe in America and I always will.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: And if you do, then we must accept this result and then look to the future.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: Donald Trump is going to be our president.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: We owe him an open mind and the chance to lead.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: Our constitutional democracy enshrines the peaceful transfer of power and we don't just respect that, we cherish it.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: It also enshrines other things; the rule of law, the principle that we are all equal in rights and dignity, freedom of worship and expression.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: We respect and cherish these values too and we must defend them.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: Now — and let me add, our constitutional democracy demands our participation, not just every four years but all the time.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: So let's do all we can to keep advancing the causes and values we all hold dear; making our economy work for everyone not just those at the top, protecting our country and protecting our planet and breaking down all the barriers that hold any American back from achieving their dreams.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: We've spent a year and a half bringing together millions of people from every corner of our country to say with one voice that we believe that the American dream is big enough for everyone — for people of all races and religions, for men and women, for immigrants, for LGBT people, and people with disabilities.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: So now, our responsibility as citizens is to keep doing our part to build that better, stronger, fairer America we seek.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: And I know you will.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: I am so grateful to stand with all of you.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: I want to thank Tim Kaine and Anne Holton for being our partners on this journey.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: It has been a joy getting to know them better, and it gives me great hope and comfort to know that Tim will remain on the front lines of our democracy representing Virginia in the Senate.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: To Barack and Michelle Obama, our country owes you an enormous debt of gratitude.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: We — we thank you for your graceful, determined leadership that has meant so much to so many Americans and people across the world.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: And to Bill and Chelsea, Mark, Charlotte, Aidan, our brothers and our entire family, my love for you means more than I can ever express.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: You crisscrossed this country on our behalf and lifted me up when I needed it most — even four-month-old Aidan who traveled with his mom.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: I will always be grateful to the creative, talented, dedicated men and women at our headquarters in Brooklyn and across our country.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: You poured your hearts into this campaign.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: For some of you who are veterans, it was a campaign after you had done other campaigns.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: Some of you, it was your first campaign.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: I want each of you to know that you were the best campaign anybody could have ever expected or wanted.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: And to the millions of volunteers, community leaders, activists and union organizers who knocked on doors, talked to neighbors, posted on Facebook, even in secret, private Facebook sites......I want everybody coming out from behind that and make sure your voices are heard going forward.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: To everyone who sent in contributions as small at $5 and kept us going, thank you.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: Thank you from all of us.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: And to the young people in particular, I hope you will hear this.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: I have, as Tim said, spent my entire adult life fighting for what I believe in.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: I've had successes and I've had setbacks.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: Sometimes, really painful ones.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: Many of you are at the beginning of your professional public and political careers.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: You will have successes and setbacks, too.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: This loss hurts, but please never stop believing that fighting for what's right is worth it.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: It is — it is worth it.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: And so we need — we need you to keep up these fights now and for the rest of your lives.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: And to all the women, and especially the young women, who put their faith in this campaign and in me, I want you to know that nothing has made me prouder than to be your champion.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: Now, I — I know — I know we have still not shattered that highest and hardest glass ceiling, but some day someone will and hopefully sooner than we might think right now.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: And — and to all the little girls who are watching this, never doubt that you are valuable and powerful and deserving of every chance and opportunity in the world to pursue and achieve your own dreams.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: Finally, I am so grateful for our country and for all it has given to me.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: I count my blessings every single day that I am an American.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: And I still believe as deeply as I ever have that if we stand together and work together with respect for our differences, strength in our convictions and love for this nation, our best days are still ahead of us.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: Because, you know — you know, I believe we are stronger together and we will go forward together.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: And you should never, ever regret fighting for that.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: You know, scripture tells us, \"Let us not grow weary in doing good, for in due season, we shall reap if we do not lose heart.\" So my friends, let us have faith in each other, let us not grow weary, let us not lose heart, for there are more seasons to come.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: And there is more work to do.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: I am incredibly honored and grateful to have had this chance to represent all of you in this consequential election.

titre: Remarks in New York City Conceding the 2016 Presidential Election
texte: May God bless you and may God bless the United States of America."
